forbidden_inferences: Official implementation rejection alone does not establish normativity.
Agreement among observer profiles does not establish normativity.
A normative source does not establish claims outside its recorded assumptions or target relationship.
rules.rationale: Established normative authority requires content-bound normative support aimed at the modeled claim, resolved assumptions and locators, no unmet qualification requirement, and no unresolved contradiction to the authority claim.

forbidden_inferences: Provisional status must not be rendered or counted as established normativity.
Implementation consensus must not silently discharge the named unmet requirement.
rules.rationale: A normative candidate may remain provisional with bounded evidence, but it must name the missing qualification rather than converting discovery or implementation evidence into authority.

forbidden_inferences: Unresolved evidence must not be collapsed into rejection policy or logical validity.
The tidier interpretation must not be selected without qualifying evidence.
rules.rationale: Unresolved normative authority requires a durable blocking question, unresolved assumption, or contradiction in addition to a named unmet requirement.

forbidden_inferences: An established empirical boundary must not be rendered as a normative requirement.
Agreement across profiles must not be described as independent voting without lineage qualification.
rules.rationale: Established empirical authority requires at least one content-bound implementation observation, a complete explicit observer vector, evidence for every concrete outcome, and no unresolved qualification requirement.

forbidden_inferences: Partial observation must not be rendered as a complete checker comparison.
A provisional scenario must not enter the normative coverage denominator.
rules.rationale: A scenario may be provisionally retained while observer inspection or attribution is incomplete, provided the missing qualification and all uninspected profiles are explicit.

forbidden_inferences: Contradictory or attribution-uncertain outcomes must remain visible.
Unresolved cross-layer behavior must not be forced into one layer.
rules.rationale: An unresolved empirical scenario preserves its complete observer vector while naming the contradiction, unresolved assumption, or blocking interpretation question.
